why: Intro to Jupyter plan, 'Restart and run all' (find the cell that fails because it leans on a deleted cell, then every cell runs in order from 1). The learner deleted the 'goal = 8000' cell, clicked Restart and stopped there: the cells still carry the old session's counts [1], [3], [4] and its output '4 of 7 days reached the goal of 8000'. No cell in the notebook defines goal any more, so a real Run All would stop at [2] with NameError: name 'goal' is not defined. A [1] is on screen and no error shows only because nothing has run since the restart.

step.title: Restart the kernel and run every cell
step.instructions: In steps.ipynb, click Restart, then Run All. Every cell should run top to bottom, numbered from [1], with no error.
step.run_command: Restart the kernel, then run all cells

checks.label: No cell error after Run All

cells.source: days_met = sum(s >= goal for s in steps)
print(f'{days_met} of 7 days reached the goal of {goal}')
